note: Burundi, read on the Commissariat Général des Migrations' services page (migration.gov.bi/Services) on 2026-10-30; its fees are set in US dollars, so the file's currency is USD. The ordinary establishment visa (Burundi's residence) is asked of the Commissioner General by one who has spent at least six months in Burundi on a current visa (in country), with an employment contract and the company's papers for an employee, or a tax number and trade register entry for any gainful activity: US$500, valid 2 years. Since it serves employees and the self-employed alike it is read as work at anything the holder's papers name ('any'); whether it is renewed isn't stated. The ordinary permanent resident visa, on the Ministry of the Interior's authorisation, asks a property title and the establishment visas held: US$1,200, valid 99 years (kept as its term). The years of establishment visas it asks aren't stated. Decision times and naturalisation's years aren't on the page.
